Baskerville42/outage-data-ua.description: Public repository of planned electricity outage data in Ukraine.
Baskerville42/outage-data-ua.body:
# outage-data-ua

A public repository and tools for automatically collecting, parsing, visualizing (HTML), and automatically generating PNG images of planned and emergency electricity outage charts in Ukraine.

The project retrieves data from public provider web pages and stores it as JSON "as is" in the `data/` directory. This data is then rendered in a fixed HTML template and converted into PNG images, which are saved to `images/<region>/gpv-x-x.png`.

---

## Data format
Each region is stored in a file `data/<region>.json`. Basic structure (abridged):

```json
{
  "regionId": "kyiv",
  "regionAffiliation": "м. Київ",
  "lastUpdated": "2025-11-06T11:41:56.430Z",
  "fact": { "updateFact": "06.11.2025 09:09" },
  "preset": { "updateFact": "04.11.2025 18:00" },
  "attention": { "text": "..." },
  "lastUpdateStatus": { "status": "parsed", "ok": true, "code": 200, "message": null, "at": "2025-11-06T11:41:56.430Z", "attempt": 5 },
  "meta": { "schemaVersion": "1.0.0", "contentHash": "...", "attentionHash": "..." }
}
```

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios

# Beiming Engine · Beiming Engine **Code as film. hello-yunshu/luci-app-nginx-manager.body:
# luci-app-nginx-manager

[English](https://github.com/hello-yunshu/luci-app-nginx-manager/blob/HEAD/README.en.md) | **中文**

  Manage Nginx sites, certificates, logs, and configuration through the LuCI web interface, with no command-line operation required.

---

## Features

### Site Management

Four site modes cover common use cases:

| Mode | Description |
|------|------|
| **Reverse Proxy** | Forward requests to a backend service; supports WebSocket and custom proxy headers |
| **Static Files** | Host local files; automatically generates `try_files` rules |
| **Custom Configuration** | Write the server block directly, with full freedom |
| **Redirect** | 301 permanent redirect to the target address |

Each site supports:
- Multiple listen ports (including SSL)
- Automatic HTTP→HTTPS redirect
- gRPC pass-through (gRPC Path + gRPC Backend Address)
- Site-level HSTS (custom max-age)
- Independent access log and error log control
- One-click enable/disable; when disabled, the configuration file is kept but not loaded by nginx
- Site duplication (one-click copy of an existing site configuration)

### SSL Certificate Management

- **Manual upload** — paste certificate and private key contents; they are stored automatically and permissions are set
- **Self-signed generation** — generate a self-signed certificate in one click, suitable for intranet testing
- **ACME automatic issuance** — based on OpenWrt `acme`; supports HTTP-01 Webroot, HTTP-01 Standalone, and DNS-01 validation
- Certificate expiry detection; certificates expiring within 30 days are automatically marked as "expiring soon"

### Real-time Logs

- View access and error logs online
- Filter by site
- Keyword filtering for quick problem localization
- Displays up to 500 lines to prevent browser lag

### Configuration Safety Mechanism

All configuration changes go through a safety process:

```
Modify UCI configuration → generate nginx conf → nginx -t test → reload on success → automatic rollback on failure
```

- **Automatic rollback** — when the configuration test fails, the previous working state is restored automatically
- **Dangerous edit mode** — available to advanced users; directly edit nginx.conf and template files
- **Configuration preview** — preview the nginx configuration to be generated before saving

keros68/binglan.body:
# Binglan Desktop

[English](https://github.com/keros68/binglan/blob/HEAD/README_en.md) · [Download](https://github.com/keros68/binglan/releases/latest) · [Quick Start](#快速开始) · [User Guide](https://github.com/keros68/binglan/blob/HEAD/docs/USER-GUIDE.md) · [Development Guide](https://github.com/keros68/binglan/blob/HEAD/docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) · [License](#许可证)

**Manage desktop info cards, to-dos, file groups, Dock, and taskbar on Windows 11 in one app.**

Binglan Desktop is a Windows 11 desktop companion built on .NET 10 and WPF. It replaces several separate tools previously used for desktop info, file organization, Dock, and taskbar beautification. All modules share one process, one tray icon, and one settings center.

## Features

- **Desktop info**: Time, date, greeting, weather, and CPU / RAM / network are separate cards, each with independently adjustable font, size, color, and position. The time and date card offers four layout presets (Classic, Minimal large numerals, Date poster, and Vertical digits), along with 12/24-hour format and date display toggles. Cards are pinned to the desktop layer, so they do not cover other program windows and remain visible after Win+D.
- **To-dos and sticky notes**: The to-do card can switch between a today list and a multi-week calendar (1–5 weeks, with lunar dates). Both share the same tasks, and the card can collapse into a title bar showing a summary of unfinished items (it shows “已全部完成” when everything is complete). Supports due dates and times, itineraries, countdown days, and linked files. Items nearing their deadline are highlighted automatically. Sticky notes support multi-line text.
- **File grouping boxes**: Map commonly used desktop files, folders, and software into boxes, which are sorted automatically by type. Supports manual adjustment and sorting by name, type, or modification time (newest first). Boxes can collapse into a title bar showing an item count (when collapsed, dragging a file onto the title bar temporarily expands the box so you can drop the file in). Per-box options include auto-collapse 5 seconds after the mouse leaves, right-click “Edge Hide” (snaps to the left or right outer screen edge as a 6 DIP colored tab strip, with transparent margins click-through; hovering at the outermost screen edge for about 250 ms, or dragging a file from outside near it for about 80 ms, slides the box out, and it retracts when the mouse leaves; multi-monitor setups exclude inner edges, and it pauses in fullscreen), and a temporary “Keep expanded” pin. Also includes multi-select, batch removal and transfer, Space to preview (compatible with QuickLook if it is already running on the machine), and a global hotkey (default `Ctrl+Alt+Space`) that temporarily floats the grouping box above the desktop so you can drag files out directly. Only paths are recorded; original files are not moved. Deleting original files is an optional feature, disabled by default, and each deletion requires confirmation before the file is moved to the Recycle Bin.
- **Quick access**: A row of line icons, by default This PC, Desktop, Documents, Downloads, Pictures, and Recycle Bin. Icons, names, and positions are all customizable. After turning off the card in the “Desktop Cards” page, it stays hidden after restart. …

# Learn Ukrainian

**Мова -- душа народу** | Language is the soul of a nation

A free, open-source Ukrainian language course from A1 to C2, based on the **Ukrainian State Standard 2024** and aligned with **CEFR**.

**[Start Learning](https://learn-ukrainian.github.io)**

---

## What is this?

A comprehensive Ukrainian language curriculum with 1,778 modules across 22 tracks:

- **6 core CEFR levels** (A1 -- C2) covering grammar, vocabulary, and communication
- **16 specialization tracks** -- history, biographies, literature, professional Ukrainian, folk culture, Old East Slavic, and Ruthenian
- **Theory-first approach** -- understand grammar deeply, not just memorize phrases
- **Interactive exercises** -- quizzes, matching, fill-in-the-blank, error correction

lingquan11/cpp-matmul-performance.body:
# C++ Matrix Multiplication Performance Analysis and Blocked Optimization Experiments

Using C++ matrix multiplication as a vehicle, I am learning how to verify program correctness, design performance comparison experiments, and analyze the results of different implementations. The project starts from the effect of loop order on memory access and then tries blocked computation. Experimental data, analysis reports, and code are stored in the repository. Through this work, I hope to gradually understand data reuse, laying a foundation for later study of NPU architecture and dataflow.

matto49/hiro-gakumas-hero.body:
# hiro-gakumas-hero · 数字小广

Lets an LLM play Gakuen Idolmaster (学マス) on its own. Everything is automated, from screenshot recognition, state inference, and decision-making to click execution and per-turn review.
The main focus is H.I.F mode (the character is Shinozawa Hiro from Campus mode). Since 2026-11, it can also handle 「初」, N.I.A, and the Idol Road (アイドルへの道). These three modes have only just been cleared, and a human often needs to step in partway through. It runs on macOS (the PlayCover fork with MaaTools), Windows with the MuMu emulator, and the Windows DMM version.

**No seed reading**: live play uses only information visible on screen. It does not read the deck order or the RNG from exam save data. This is a rule for the whole project (since 2026-11-12). Search that "knows the card order in advance" is used only as a reference upper bound in offline evaluation.

> This is an unofficial personal research project, unaffiliated with the game's developer or operator. The repository's `assets/pack/` includes a set of game assets used for recognition (card art, icons, fonts, UI images, layouts). **These assets belong to the game's rights holders and are not covered by this repository's open-source license.** They are provided only for research on recognizing game screens. See [assets/pack/README.md](https://github.com/matto49/hiro-gakumas-hero/blob/HEAD/assets/pack/README.md) for details. The main data is not in the repository. `setup.sh` downloads it from public sources.

## Results

### H.I.F

As of 2026-11-04, the H.I.F main event (combined total across both rounds, 1st place) has been won 6 times. Two of those wins were full runs starting from the selection stage. Exam and training decisions and clicks are fully automated by the program. When it reaches a screen it does not yet handle, it stops and waits for a human. Places where a human had to intervene have been added to the code. Examples include the first-time setup dialog in run 33 and the enhancement page triggered by P items.

| Run | Format | Combined (both rounds) | R1 | R2 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 20 | Main event only | 1,108,753 | 678,478 | 430,275 |
| 21 | **Full run** (selection: three stages all full stars → main event) | 1,200,550 | 541,016 | 659,534 |
| 22 | Main event only | 1,228,979 | 620,481 | 608,498 |
| 31 | Main event only | **1,303,847** | 538,425 | 765,422 |
| 32 | Main event only | 1,135,657 | 549,384 | 586,273 |
| 33 | **Full run** | 1,094,909 | 450,164 | 644,745 |

The top rival (十王星南) holds steady at about 1.08 million combined across both rounds.

The results above were achieved on macOS. At that time, the author's system read decrypted exam save data to get the board state. It no longer reads save data. Exam board states are now always inferred from the screen.

wearetheone777/dumate2api.body:
# dumate2api

> For architecture and detailed code walkthrough, see [ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/wearetheone777/dumate2api/blob/HEAD/ARCHITECTURE.md).

**Five upstreams → three-protocol gateway.** Unifies DuMate (Baidu 搭子), Qianwen Office, TRAE Work, Qoder, and WorkBuddy into **OpenAI / Anthropic / Google-compatible APIs** for clients such as Codex CLI, Claude Code, and cc-switch. Includes a web console for managing accounts, check-ins, points, and request telemetry. For the full usage guide, see **[User Manual](https://github.com/wearetheone777/dumate2api/blob/HEAD/docs/USER_MANUAL.md)**.

```
Codex CLI ──── OpenAI / Responses ─┐
Claude Code ──── Anthropic ────────┼──→ dumate2api ──┬──→ DuMate (Baidu 搭子) (web credentials / local :8980)
any client ──── Google ────────────┘                 ├──→ Qianwen Office (direct in-process)
                                                    ├──→ TRAE Work (direct in-process)
                                                    ├──→ Qoder (direct in-process)
                                                    └──→ WorkBuddy (direct in-process, dual region cn / global)
```

## Features

- **Three protocols + Responses**: full coverage of OpenAI / Anthropic / Google, including the `responses` wire format required by Codex CLI 0.155+
- **Five-channel prefix routing**: explicit routing by model-name prefix; unknown prefixes return 400 directly and never silently fall back
- **Zero client dependencies**: all five channels hold their own credentials. Qianwen and Qoder signing is a pure local algorithm, and WorkBuddy's browser serves only as the authorization surface. None require official clients
- **Zero third-party gateway dependencies**: uses only Node built-in modules (`playwright-core` is used only by the admin console's browser login helper)
- **Web console**: dashboard, model management, points breakdown (including monthly/yearly check-in details), usage statistics, request logs, and a chat test bench
- **Check-ins and points**: check-ins are idempotent and can be scheduled; lottery draws are irreversible, so they remain manual-only

This project redoes the Geely Galaxy's “unlock when approaching / lock when leaving” feature: **the phone decides by itself whether you are approaching or leaving, then connects the Galaxy app's Bluetooth key for you and unlocks the car.**

The “passive entry” switch in the head unit can stay off; this app does not depend on it.

[⬇️ Download APK](https://github.com/yangyongyongyong/GeelyPassiveKey/releases/latest) · [v4.0 design notes](https://github.com/yangyongyongyong/GeelyPassiveKey/blob/HEAD/docs/36_minimal_generic_passive_key.md) · [Reverse-engineering knowledge base](https://github.com/yangyongyongyong/GeelyPassiveKey/blob/HEAD/docs/)

> At a glance: scan for this car → connection trigger → Galaxy authentication → unlock on approach → confirm departure and lock. The connection-trigger threshold is not the same as the approach-unlock threshold.

The current source version is **v4.6.9-min (build 609)**: it fixes an issue where the old notification re-check still locked an extra time after the current RemoteViews button had already delivered successfully. Now, the one-time lock re-check is only allowed if a cached token was actually used. When notifications are missing, a conservative GATT learning fallback is added: the car is saved only when the system has exactly one LE connection explicitly named `GeelyAuto` / `Geely_Auto` or a Geely car name. Multiple Geely connections, or ordinary earbuds or watches, are still refused rather than guessed. The v4.6.8 scan-callback health watchdog, the official Galaxy 1.59 / Android 16 current-button priority, and notification snapshot age validation are all retained. Default parameters remain: connect `≥ -95 dBm`, approach unlock `≥ -75 dBm`, departure lock `≤ -85 dBm`, departure confirmation `2.0 seconds`. Upgrading does not overwrite user settings. See…

youufis/SmartKBS.body:
# SmartKBS — Smart Teaching Platform

> **🌐 [中文](https://github.com/youufis/SmartKBS/blob/HEAD/README.md) | [English](https://github.com/youufis/SmartKBS/blob/HEAD/README.en.md)**
>
> **An AI smart teaching platform for the three stages of primary, junior high, and senior high school** — subjects, grades, and classes are all driven by configuration, **not limited to any single subject**.
>
> Covers five main lines — **Teach · Learn · Practice · Assess · Manage** — with 51 functional sections grouped into six chapters by main line, for 60+ feature points in total:
>
> - 🏠 **Entry · Home and To-dos** — Smart dashboard, student task list (multi-dimensional filtering · multiple views · simplified mode)
> - 🧑‍🏫 **Teach · Teaching and Resources** — Course outline (five-level tree · three visibility levels), AI lectures, AI podcasts, AI teaching assistant, smart question bank (generation / extraction / manual entry / jump-to-question-number) and tag maintenance, online exams, intelligent test assembly with Word export (native formulas), AI resource recommendation, AI-generated HTML resources, resource center and management, file center
> - 🎓 **Learn · Learning and Practice** — AI chat (knowledge Q&A), AI learning companion, exploration canvas (AI-accompanied infinite canvas), course practice, synchronized practice, error-correction review, daily selections and trending news, code practice
> - 🎪 **Practice · Classroom Activities** — In-class quizzes, classroom polls, question management, classroom random questioning, classroom challenges, knowledge quick-answer, group discussions, collaborative whiteboard, smart roll call and attendance, knowledge challenges, homework center (dialogue / files · AI grading · submission roster and reminders)
> - 📊 **Assess · Learning Analytics and Motivation** — AI learning analytics, AI classroom summaries, teaching briefings, progress and activity monitoring, data export, growth profiles, my portrait, 12-level titles and achievement badges, automatic points rewards
> - ⚙️ **Manage · System Administration** — Users and permissions (CSV batch import in seconds), system announcements, notification center, skill management, system configuration (cloud/local dual engine · global briefing policy · log rotation and retention), online incremental upgrades, multiple theme appearances
>
> Built on **FastAPI + React**, integrating Alibaba Cloud DashScope (Tongyi Qianwen / Tongyi Wanxiang), DeepSeek, and local Ollama engines (cloud / hybrid / local modes); SSE streaming output and WebSocket real-time links support concurrent classroom use, and all data is stored locally in SQLite and local directories, enabling fully offline deployment.
